The Title Adora Rawai

Condominium in Rawai
HomeNew ProjectsThe Title Adora Rawai

Project overview

Coastal condominium in Rawai on Phuket's west coast, designed around sea views and a Mediterranean-inspired concept.

Units range from 30 sqm one-bedroom layouts to 87 sqm two-bedroom layouts. Construction progress was reported at about 69% in October 2026.

Prices, availability and the full facilities list are provided on request: message us on WhatsApp.

Frequently asked questions

Where is The Title Adora Rawai?

The Title Adora Rawai is a condominium project in Rawai, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).

What is the starting price of The Title Adora Rawai?

Agent advertised price is ฿5,698,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at The Title Adora Rawai?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will The Title Adora Rawai be ready?

Current status: under construction; completion date listed as 2027-03. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
